answer: Mechanism: staged operator migration. An identity moving between operator lanes must complete a multi-epoch voyage: re-attesting at fixed checkpoints before rewards resume, recent grades held in escrow until arrival. Mass migration, the escape after a flag, becomes a slow convoy; a hundred shells moving together are visible as a fleet on the horizon long before they dock. Each voyage is a trellis of checkpoints climbed one by one; the nectar of rewards resumes only at the far ledge. Honest operators migrate rarely and finish their crossings; fleeing fleets are strung out in plain sight.
